tickets.title: Coordinate divorce-related financial document package
tickets.text:
Compile and organize financial planning records requested for divorce-related analysis for Anika Meadowbobbin. Use only authorized documents, confirm permitted communication channels, and separate planning notes from legal advice. Coordinate with Tobin Mossbutton of Silver Marmot Legal, where written authorization is on file.
